page.overview:
Who is Abraxas?

Abraxas wanted to conquer the world. To this end he decided he needed to kill Spider-Man and discovered Spider-Man's identity as Peter Parker (presumably through his telepathy). He convinced Peter's friend Tim Huxley to give Peter a bomb to kill him. After Peter obtained the present it was stolen and exploded, killing the thieves. Peter returned to Huxley and confronted Abraxas and the pair fought but Abraxas used his telepathy to forsee every move Spider-Man tried. Huxley turned on Abraxas but Abraxas saw this an injured Huxley. This gave Spider-Man the opportunity to web up Abraxas but was interpreted by the police, forcing Spider-Man to free and Abraxas to escape. Abraxas later telepathically reached out to Spider-Man and said they would meet again.

Later Abraxas kidnapped Gwen Stacy and attempted to reveal Peter's identity as Spider-Man to her. However she didn't listen and fainted. He took her to an abandoned warehouse and tried to tell her more, but they were interrupted by Spider-Man. Initially Abraxas again had the upper hand because of his telepathy, however when Spider-Man had a guitarist play loud music nearby, Abraxas found he could no longer conctrate and was swiftly defeated by Spider-Man and left tied up for the police.
